dedupe_keys.name: crosscert public benchmark repository of building data for energy performance certificates

description: The crossCert benchmark repository is a public set of documented real buildings for testing Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) procedures across Europe. It was created by the crossCert consortium, a Horizon 2020 project, and each building is a separate Zenodo record in the crossCert community, most published on 17 October 2023. On 2026-09-26 the community held 78 records, of which 53 are case buildings from Austria, Bulgaria, Denmark, Spain, Greece, Croatia, Poland and the United Kingdom: educational buildings, multi-apartment buildings, single-family houses, offices, healthcare and administrative buildings. Each record holds a neutral data inventory, a neutral results report, the original EPC certificate and, where available, measured energy consumption, in the national language and English. Access: open download per building from Zenodo, with a readme. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: files and completeness vary by building, and measured data are not always provided. Simulation uses are validating building energy models and certificate methods against measured consumption, and calibrating archetypes for stock models. Related records: EPC registers and the GECAD smart building datasets.
name: crossCert public benchmark repository of building data for Energy Performance Certificates
